title: Nanhi Si Jaan
body:
nanhi si jaan jaan se bejaan hogayi
asghar hase to maut bhi hairaan ho gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
baachon se jiske doodh ki khushboo nahi gayi
be-taygh jisne lashkar e aada se jang ki
jo hurmala ke maut ka saaman ho gayi
asghar hase to...
nanhi si jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
saanson ki toot’ti hui dori gawaah hai
nauha jo ban gayi thi wo lori gawaah hai
asghar ki jang fatha ka alaan ho gayi
asghar hase to...
nanhi si jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tashna labi mein teer ko sairaab kar diya
poora dil e hussain ka har khwaab kar diya
tabeer e khwaab marziye yazdan ho gayi
asghar hase to...
nanhi si jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoole mein reh ke shauq e shahadat jawan tha
asghar ka shauq maa ke liye imtehan tha
maa shauq pe sagheer ke qurban ho gayi
asghar hase to...
nanhi si jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo teer ran mein jaanib e quran tha chala
asghar ne pesh kar diya haste huwe gala
is tarha se hifazat e quran ho gayi
asghar hase to...
nanhi si jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha likha hai aap ne us bezuban ka
khushnoodi e hussain hai jis nauhe ka sila
bakhshish to yun bhi aap ki rehaan ho gayi
asghar hase to...
nanhi si jaan...
author: Rehaan Azmi
